Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is an affinity-capture screen to identify the PtdIns(3,4,5)P3 interactome. While the paper discusses DAPP1 knockout mice and agonist stimulation (thrombin, CRP), these are functional validation assays (thrombosis, aggregometry, FACS) and not the primary high-resolution proteomic MS experiment described in the PRIDE metadata and methods. The MS experiment compares proteins captured by PtdIns(3,4,5)P3-beads versus control beads and competition controls.
